alternative_explanations: Any gain may come from pooled sample count rather than reusable representation; the independent same-architecture control isolates that explanation.
Specialists may win because the common serializer removes useful native structure, not because shared representation is impossible.
confounds: Sequence length or structural pattern could reveal family identity even though no label, type name or oracle field is supplied.
Fixed-width deterministic compression can discard different fractions of the four public supports; acquisition and truncation are recorded but may affect capability.
falsification_criteria: Kill this implementation if overall unseen-world transfer is below 0.95, any family mean is below 0.90, or the independent/no-shared version matches it at no higher full cost.

Kill the mechanism claim if a simpler shared empirical or autoregressive control or the specialist suite Pareto-dominates the shared learner after acquisition, meta-fit, update, query, state and R16 workload are included.

outcome_policy.negative: A crash or invalid output rejects only the implementation; leakage, seed collision or evaluator-integrity change invalidates the run, while decisive matched-capability dominance makes this route dormant without post-hoc adapters.
outcome_policy.null: A null keeps HYP-0015 proposed or dormant and identifies whether lack of transfer, no advantage over independent training, or full-cost dominance is responsible; do not tune this cohort.
outcome_policy.positive: A one-seed positive is surprising screening evidence only and authorizes a preregistered three-seed adversarial screen with unchanged learner and evaluator.

predicted_outcome: The first quick will likely be null: the shared learner may transfer relational regularities but will fail at least one 0.90 family gate or remain Pareto-dominated by the fully charged specialist suite; a genuine large positive would justify only a replicated screen.
promotion_criteria: Quick cannot promote; authorize only a three-seed screen if shared_cross_family_learner has transfer at least 0.95, minimum-family accuracy at least 0.90, no family trails the best shared control by more than 0.02, beats independent_cross_family_learner, and is implementably non-dominated.
research_question: Can one source-identical local learner discover a pooled representation that transfers to runner-random unseen probabilistic, predictive-state, local-dynamics and program-composition worlds at better full-system capability per cost than separate family-specific models?
title: One unchanged learner across four unseen world families

invalidation_rules: Invalidate on any derived training and scoring seed collision.
Invalidate if the shared candidate receives a family label or privileged native object.
Invalidate on candidate tuning after any scoring output is observed.
Invalidate if public serialization contains oracle-only fields or derived latent roles.
